One of the weirdest tells I picked up from a few days tinkering w AI writing was that when it describes someone, it almost always has them doing nothing. So if you see a passage and the subject is being described in any way as doing nothing, it’s probably AI.


kang (@jaycaspiankang)

I made a game that tests your ability to tell AI writing from some of the great books on Project Gutenberg. Has been pretty interesting to see the results and get to know the tics of AI. Give it a try before I run
The harry maguire online fight has made me understand some things about the Brits
Alright let’s get a Knicks sweep here so they can rest up fully in case they have to play OKC. Also I feel like Giannis should be able to join them for the finals.
